svg.aria-label: A surface tilted away from the sun, drawn with the sunlight running straight down the page and one column per shadow-map texel, and the one flat depth the map stores per texel, the surface's depth at the texel's centre. In every texel the surface's far half tests behind the stored value and shadows itself.
